IGUI_perks_Right Side_Description: Knowledge of amputations on the right side of the body
IGUI_perks_Left Side_Description: Knowledge of amputations on the left side of the body
IGUI_Confirmation_Amputate: <CENTRE> Do you really want to amputate that limb?
IGUI_TOC_SW_Self: You are going to operate on yourself.
IGUI_TOC_SW_Missing_Tourniquet: no tourniquet on that side: heavy bleeding. Make one from ripped sheets or a belt and a stick, and wear it on that limb.
IGUI_TOC_SW_Missing_Disinfect: no alcohol or disinfectant: the wound starts dirty
IGUI_TOC_SW_Missing_Incision: no blade: the saw tears the flesh
IGUI_TOC_SW_Missing_Bone: no saw or axe at hand
IGUI_TOC_SW_Missing_Stitches: no needle and thread: the stump will bleed for longer
IGUI_TOC_SW_Knows: You know how a field amputation is done.
IGUI_TOC_SW_NoKnowledge: You have never done this. A Field Amputation Guide would help.
IGUI_TOC_SW_Warn_OneHanded: You are working with one hand.
IGUI_TOC_SW_Warn_Self: Operating on yourself: you may faint half way through.
IGUI_TOC_SW_Warn_Scream: The patient will scream (heard %1 tiles away).
IGUI_TOC_SW_RiskUnknown: You could not say how risky this is.
IGUI_TOC_Surgery_Result_1: The %1 is gone. It went badly: the stump is a mess.
IGUI_TOC_Surgery_Result_2: The %1 is gone. Something tore: the stump is bleeding hard.
IGUI_TOC_Cure_late: It was too late. The fever is still there.
IGUI_TOC_Cure_doomed: The bite that matters is somewhere else.
IGUI_TOC_Cure_none: There was no infection to begin with.
IGUI_TOC_ProsthesisWorn: The prosthesis is about to give out.
IGUI_TOC_Sepsis_Start: The stump is hot and swollen.
IGUI_TOC_Sepsis_Bad: Fever. The stump stinks. Antibiotics, now.
IGUI_TOC_PhantomPain: The limb that is not there hurts.
IGUI_TOC_NeedCrutch: I cannot walk like this. I need a crutch or a prosthesis.
IGUI_TOC_Crawling: No legs. All I can do is crawl.
IGUI_TOC_HookCantHold: I cannot hold that with a hook.
IGUI_TOC_NoHandForThat: I have no hand for that.
IGUI_TOC_Symptom_2: I am sweating and my wound burns.
IGUI_TOC_Symptom_4: I can barely stand. It is in my blood.
IGUI_TOC_Diag_infected: This wound is infected with the Knox virus.
IGUI_TOC_Diag_infected_Maybe: This does not look good. Probably infected.
IGUI_TOC_Diag_clean_Maybe: It looks all right, I think.
IGUI_TOC_SawSputters: It sputters and dies. Pull again.
IGUI_TOC_SawNoFuel: The tank is empty: refuel it with petrol.
IGUI_TOC_SawStalled: The chainsaw runs dry and stalls.
IGUI_TOC_SawArmBusy: Your right hand is a chainsaw.
